units.text: INT. PLANETARIUM - DOME CHAMBER - NIGHT
A great hemisphere of dark.
The projector, a hulking brass insect, squats at the center under a canvas sheet.
Rows of reclined seats fan out like petals.
An EXIT sign throws red on the carpet.
INES VARELA (30s, black overalls, a headlamp shut off around her neck) steps from the aisle with a steady, practiced walk.
She tests the first row with her toe.
She counts seats under her breath.
Behind her, GASPARD LEROY (50s, charcoal suit, soft hands, the museum's night director) follows at a respectful distance, a heavy ring of keys hanging from his belt.
She goes to the projector and lifts the canvas.
He sets down his flashlight, smiling, as one smiles at a favored guest.
She reaches under the brass collar and finds the hinge.
He folds his hands, and watches her work, and says nothing.
You're calm.
units.name: INES

units.text: It's my building.
units.name: GASPARD

units.text: That's what makes it strange.
units.name: INES

units.text: She twists a latch.
A panel opens.
Inside, wrapped in velvet, sits a dark gem the size of a plum.
She lifts it out with both hands, turns it in the red light.
He takes one step closer.
Would you like to see the sky?
units.name: GASPARD

units.text: Not tonight.
units.name: INES

units.text: I insist. It's the only real thing in here.
units.name: GASPARD

units.text: He pulls a lever on the wall without looking.
The dome blooms with stars, thousands, slowly rotating overhead.
She tips her head back for one unguarded second, and the gem glints in her palm.
When she lowers her eyes, he is holding her keys.
She did not see him take them.
He steps back, out of reach, and the stars wheel across his face.
The stone is paste, you know. I sold the real one in March.
units.name: GASPARD

units.text: Then why leave the case?
units.name: INES

units.text: So that someone would come tonight.
units.name: GASPARD

units.text: She sets the fake on a seat.
He pockets her keys.
The sky above them turns.
Who?
units.name: INES

units.text: The man who bought it.
units.name: GASPARD

units.text: A door opens somewhere in the dark.
Slow steps descend the aisle, unhurried, a third pair of shoes on carpet.
She does not turn.
He does not look.
Together they watch the dome as if it might still save them.
